jo805m:179: Once expression is no longer hindered, the next challenge is "staying on topic." ljg-writes emphasizes making a single incision on one viewpoint, which requires the author to clearly define the core thesis before starting to write. In an era where AI-assisted writing is increasingly common, the value of this Skill is especially prominent — because LLMs naturally tend to generate content that covers everything but goes shallow on each point, while the "focus" principle of ljg-writes runs against the LLM's instinct. It requires human authors to retain judgment over information density.
kakdbg:46: Before being able to express effectively, you first need to remove the "noise" that hinders communication — jargon, translationese, redundant modifiers. This is similar to the "subtraction mindset" in the ljg skill system: before adding any expression techniques, ensure the basic information is conveyed clearly. ljg-plain targets not only the text itself, but also the author's unconscious writing habits — when a person is used to masking insufficient thinking with complex sentence structures, plain writing actually forces the author to think clearly before writing.
